items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Sterling. I see how it was. Oh, it's your crumb crushes.

ctx.x: Texas? Yeah, I was here. Oh, I was here.

You came out here. Oh, what are crumb crushes? Are you talking about that yet? It's your teeth. Oh, your teeth. Oh, your teeth. What? We were talking to a friend. I didn't know if he had dental work or what. Sterling. I see how it was. Oh, it's your crumb crushes.
